provenance.platform: Linux (ubuntu-24.04 GitHub-hosted runner, x86_64), Xvfb display
provenance.harness: browser started on a fresh user-data-dir with the echo URL as its command-line URL; response and page calls read back over the DevTools protocol; launch args: --no-first-run --no-default-browser-check --no-sandbox --disable-gpu
provenance.note: page fetch() to the same origin with two custom headers (x-custom-1, x-custom-2) and content-type; later connection of the same session, so its TLS part carries pre_shared_key from resumption and is not used for TLS comparison; referer, content-type and the custom headers are left out of request_headers, their names and positions kept in request_header_names
